Aurangabad — officially renamed Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar but still universally known in industrial and trade documentation as Aurangabad — is Maharashtra's most industrially significant interior city. Three MIDC zones cover the city's manufacturing belt. Bajaj Auto runs its flagship plant from MIDC Waluj. Auto component manufacturers, pharma units, and consumer goods producers fill the Chikalthana and Shendra estates. And the Delhi–Mumbai Industrial Corridor passes through the Aurangabad node, making it one of India's planned industrial cities for the next decade of investment.

Every factory under construction needs a site office. Every operating plant needs a security cabin at the gate. Every warehouse yard needs a store room that locks. SAMAN manufactures all of these.

We build MS-frame steel porta cabins at our Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, Greater Noida facility (201308) and dispatch to Aurangabad. Transit from our Greater Noida factory to Aurangabad MIDC addresses is typically 4 to 6 days by road. We are an ISO-certified manufacturer — three accredited certifications, over 500 projects since 2009. View our porta cabin catalogue or call us directly.

Aurangabad's Three MIDC Zones and What Each Needs

Understanding the industrial geography of Aurangabad matters for two reasons: it tells you whether your specific MIDC address can receive our delivery vehicle, and it tells us which route and entry coordination to plan.

MIDC Waluj (PIN 431136): The largest and oldest of Aurangabad's three industrial zones, Waluj is home to Bajaj Auto's main production facility, its Tier-1 supplier network, and a broad base of auto component manufacturers — Endurance Technologies, Minda Industries, and dozens of smaller precision engineering units. New warehouse and factory shed construction inside Waluj is ongoing. The requirement here is typically a wired 20 ft × 8 ft site office for the project manager, a 10 ft × 8 ft security cabin at the new factory entry, and occasionally a 40 ft × 8 ft labour rest room for migrant construction workers.

MIDC Chikalthana (PIN 431006): Located on Jalna Road near Aurangabad airport, Chikalthana is the city's second major zone, hosting pharma manufacturing units, consumer electronics assembly, and engineering firms. Factory expansion in Chikalthana for pharma capacity addition has been consistent. Site offices for project contractors, quality inspection rooms, and temporary administrative buildings are the common porta cabin requirements here.

MIDC Shendra — AURIC (Aurangabad Industrial City): The newest and most planned of Aurangabad's industrial zones, Shendra is part of the Delhi–Mumbai Industrial Corridor (DMIC) node. It is designed for large-format manufacturing — heavy engineering, logistics parks, and anchor investment projects. Construction activity at Shendra is in early-to-mid stages for many plots, which means active demand for contractor site offices during the project development phase.

We deliver to all three zones. Confirm your MIDC plot address, plot number, and any vehicle entry authorisation procedure when placing your order.

Why a Direct Manufacturer for an Aurangabad MIDC Site

The Aurangabad MIDC buyer is sophisticated. Auto component plants run quality audits. Pharma units require vendor documentation. Project managers at DMIC-node factories have procurement procedures. When you buy a porta cabin from a dealer or a local fabricator, you get a product with no quality paper trail.

When you buy from SAMAN, you buy from the manufacturer with:

ISO 9001:2015 — Quality Management Systems
Certificate E20250218645. Every SAMAN cabin is built under a documented quality management system. Material receipt is logged. Weld quality is inspected before panel fixing. Finished dimensions are verified against your order before dispatch. For MIDC vendors who need a quality declaration with their purchase, we provide it.

ISO 14001:2015 — Environmental Management (E20250218646)
ISO 45001:2018 — Occupational Health and Safety (E20250218647)

NSIC Registration: NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207
DPIIT Recognition: DIPP56005
GST Registration (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT

Structural MS frame and base warranty: 5 years. Panel finishing, roofing, and paint: 1 to 2 years. Engineered service life: 20 to 25 years. 500+ prefab steel structure projects completed since 2009.

For auto sector vendors in Waluj or pharma buyers in Chikalthana who need vendor certification documentation — ISO certificates, NSIC registration, DPIIT recognition, and GST papers — we include these with your order file on request.

Call +91 87960 39938 directly for North India enquiries.

Specifications — What Every SAMAN Porta Cabin Is Built From

Every cabin begins with the frame. Mild steel IS 2062 grade hollow sections — structural grade, the same IS designation used in industrial shed columns and pre-engineered building purlins. Factory-cut, welded, weld-inspected, and primed at our Greater Noida facility before a single panel is fixed.

Frame: IS 2062 MS hollow section. Factory-welded, anti-rust primed and painted. No field welding at your Aurangabad site.

Panels: 40mm PUF sandwich panel as standard — polyurethane foam core, pre-painted steel skin, genuine thermal insulation. Cement fibre board available for heavy-traffic or long-service applications.

Roof: GI sheet with zinc anti-corrosion coating. Single-skin standard. Double-skin for sites with prolonged direct summer sun exposure — relevant for open MIDC Waluj plots with no adjacent shade structure.

Floor: Anti-skid chequered steel sheet. 18mm plywood-on-MS cross-members for office-use interiors. Tile floor in toilet compartments.

Doors: MS powder-coated single-leaf or double-leaf door with mortise lock. Painted wooden door with steel frame available.

Windows: Sliding glass in aluminium frame, fixed MS mesh vent, or jalousie louvre — any combination specified at order stage.

Standard sizes for Aurangabad MIDC delivery:

SizeMIDC application
8 ft × 6 ftSecurity checkpoint kiosk, metre room
10 ft × 8 ftFactory gate security cabin, sample store
12 ft × 8 ftSite engineer office, quality inspection room
20 ft × 8 ftProject manager site office, wired
20 ft × 10 ftLarge site office with partition option
40 ft × 8 ftLabour rest room, long tool store, canteen

Custom sizes built to your MIDC plot footprint. If your Shendra or Waluj site has a specific setback or height restriction, send us the constraint and we design to fit.

Customisation — Specified Before Manufacturing, Permanent After

Electrical fit-out:
Single-phase wiring from cabin entry point. MCB board with circuit breakers sized to your declared load — laptop and printer, power tools, air conditioner, industrial testing equipment. Earth leakage protection. Wall switches and sockets at specified positions. LED fittings. External power inlet for generator connection on construction sites without permanent power. For MIDC Waluj sites where the new factory connection is pending, we design the cabin wiring for generator input so you are operational from day one.

Air conditioner provision:
Panel cut-out at the height your split AC indoor unit needs. Bracket welded on cabin exterior for outdoor compressor. Copper pipe sleeve through panel wall. Condensate drain outlet at floor level. Your AC technician installs the unit on arrival — no improvised drilling.

False ceiling:
12mm plywood or PVC tongue-and-groove on MS sub-frame at 7 to 7.5 feet clear height. Reduces cabin volume for more efficient cooling — relevant for Aurangabad's summer months when temperatures reach 38 to 42°C. Also provides an acoustically cleaner office environment on noisy MIDC construction sites.

Toilet compartment:
4 ft × 4 ft or 5 ft × 4 ft wet room. FRP tank (500 or 1,000 litre) on roof frame. WC, wash basin, floor trap, soil pipe outlet. Tile floor and 4-foot tile dado on walls. Plumbing to your site connection point. Standard addition for long-stay project offices in Waluj and Chikalthana.

Partition wall:
Plywood or gypsum-on-MS-stud dividing a long cabin into two rooms, each with a door. For auto sector project sites where the commercial manager and the technical manager share one cabin footprint.

Ventilation for Aurangabad summer:
Aurangabad's interior Maharashtra climate means hot, dry summers and a distinct monsoon. Upper wall louvre vents create passive cross-ventilation in un-air-conditioned cabins — useful for security posts and store rooms where AC is not warranted.

Exterior:
Primer plus two-coat enamel in your colour. Company name board. For Bajaj vendor sites where the company branding on the site office matters for client visits, we include a printed PVC board or enamel painted panel on the cabin front.

Delivery to Aurangabad from Greater Noida

Dispatch point: Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, Greater Noida 201308, Uttar Pradesh
Route: Yamuna Expressway south from Greater Noida to Agra, then NH 52 via Gwalior–Indore–Dhule–Aurangabad, or NH 48 via Pune approach depending on current route conditions
Distance: approximately 1,300 to 1,400 kilometres
Transit: 4 to 6 days road transit to Aurangabad MIDC addresses

The cabin travels on a flatbed truck. A crane or telehandler is required at your MIDC delivery point for offloading. A 5-tonne mobile crane handles cabins up to 20 ft × 8 ft with standard fit-out. Heavy fitted units need 7.5 tonnes. We confirm the exact cabin weight and lifting markings with your delivery note.

Placement surface: compacted murrum, paver block, or existing concrete is sufficient for temporary or semi-permanent use. For permanent factory compound installations — a security cabin at a Waluj or Chikalthana factory gate that will remain for the life of the plant — we include anchor bolt fixing plates in the base frame and supply the bolt pattern drawing to your civil team in advance.

We deliver to MIDC Waluj (431136), MIDC Chikalthana (431006), MIDC Shendra (AURIC area), and all Aurangabad city and Aurangabad district addresses. For industrial estate entries requiring advance vehicle authorisation — which Waluj in particular requires for heavy vehicles — inform us of the procedure and contact name when placing your order. We coordinate with your site supervisor.

Our prefab site office cabin is the most requested model for MIDC project sites. For the full range of sizes and configurations available from our Greater Noida facility, see porta cabin specifications and sizes.

Nearby North India pages with live delivery records: porta cabin in Pune and porta cabin in Nagpur.

Pricing — Line-Item Quotation for Aurangabad MIDC Buyers

Every cabin is priced to your specification. No published price covers every configuration. For MIDC procurement processes where you need a formal written quotation with line-item breakup before raising a purchase order, that is exactly what we provide.

Size: All material and labour scales with external footprint. Accurate dimensions at enquiry give you a quotation that matches what arrives.

Panel type: 40mm PUF sandwich panel is standard and most cost-effective. Cement fibre board at a similar price point for higher durability applications.

Fit-out level: Bare MS structure with door and window is the base. Full electrical, AC provision, false ceiling, partition, and toilet at the other end. Each item is a separate line in your quotation.

Freight: Aurangabad is 1,300 to 1,400 kilometres from our Greater Noida factory. Freight reflects the vehicle requirement for the cabin size and weight. Quoted as a separate transparent line — no hidden delivery charges built into the unit price.

Documentation: ISO certificate pack, NSIC registration, GST registration, and any manufacturer declaration required for your MIDC vendor qualification is supplied at no additional charge on request.

Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry with your cabin size, use, MIDC address, and any documentation requirement. Written quotation with complete line-item breakup within 24 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you deliver porta cabins to MIDC Waluj, Aurangabad, from your Greater Noida factory?

Yes. We dispatch from our Greater Noida facility (PIN 201308) and deliver to MIDC Waluj (PIN 431136), MIDC Chikalthana (PIN 431006), MIDC Shendra, and all Aurangabad addresses. Transit is 4 to 6 days by road. For MIDC Waluj heavy-vehicle entries, share the entry authorisation procedure and contact when placing your order — we coordinate the delivery vehicle clearance with your site team.

How long does manufacturing and delivery take from Greater Noida to Aurangabad?

Standard cabins without custom fit-out: 7 to 10 working days manufacture, then 4 to 6 days transit. Fully custom cabins with electrical, AC provision, partition, and toilet: 12 to 18 working days manufacture, then 4 to 6 days transit. We confirm both dates in writing when you place the order. For MIDC procurement, we can provide a formal delivery commitment letter on company letterhead on request.

Do you supply vendor documentation for auto sector quality audits at MIDC Waluj, Aurangabad?

Yes. We supply ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certificate copies, NSIC registration certificate (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT recognition (DIPP56005), and GST registration (09ABBCS7101B1ZT) as part of your order documentation file. If your Bajaj or Tier-1 auto supplier audit requires a manufacturer's quality declaration or material compliance statement, request it at order stage and we include it with your delivery paperwork.

Can you supply 4 to 6 porta cabins for a large factory construction project at MIDC Shendra, Aurangabad?

Yes. Multi-unit orders for large construction projects are planned as a manufacturing batch. We confirm the size and fit-out for each unit, sequence production so all units complete in one batch, and dispatch in a coordinated delivery. For DMIC-node projects at Shendra where the construction schedule is formal and phased, we can align our dispatch dates to your project timeline. Call with the project scope and we build the supply plan.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For porta cabins in Aurangabad, MIDC Waluj, Chikalthana, Shendra, or Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar district, contact our North India team:

+91 87960 39938 | +91 97089 89937

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. When using the enquiry form, include your cabin size, use, MIDC address, quantity, and any documentation requirement — we return a complete written quotation and documentation pack without a follow-up call.
